hero.sub: Every year, concessional credit sits unclaimed — not because people don't qualify, but because the system to reach it was never built for them. Uddhar is that missing shelter: the right scheme, the real cost, and a partner who can actually pay out.

stats.stat4Text: Existing tools that check if a partner can actually pay

flow.label: The lift, in three motions
flow.title: Not a search bar. A sequence that ends in funding.
flow.desc: Each step exists because the one before it is useless alone — a scheme match without a real cost is a guess, and a cost without a working partner is a dead end.
flow.step1Body: Income, project cost, and purpose go in. A deterministic rule engine — not a guess, not a black box — returns the one scheme that actually fits: Micro Finance, Term Loan, or Educational Loan.
flow.step2Body: The real EMI, at the scheme's true interest band and moratorium — seen before a single form is filed at a bank. No surprises at the counter.
flow.step3Body: The nearest authorized partner, filtered by fund health — NPA levels, utilization, overdues — before it's ever shown. Distance alone was never the right filter.
